summary_en: This study tests non-chemotherapy approaches, including strength training, activity tracking, intermittent fasting, and the beta-blocker propranolol, in people with multiple myeloma or smoldering myeloma. Strength training is done online twice a week with a Fitbit for 6 months (9 months in one group), fasting is done for 1 month, and propranolol is taken by mouth twice a day for 3 months. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study phase is listed as NA (not applicable).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa intervenciones sin quimioterapia, como entrenamiento de fuerza, seguimiento de actividad física, ayuno intermitente y el betabloqueador propranolol, en personas con mieloma múltiple o mieloma latente. El entrenamiento de fuerza se hace en línea dos veces por semana con un Fitbit durante 6 meses (9 meses en un grupo), el ayuno se realiza durante 1 mes y el propranolol se toma por vía oral dos veces al día durante 3 meses. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; la fase del estudio aparece como NA (no aplica).
who_for: Smoldering multiple myeloma, multiple myeloma, or plasma cell leukemia (modules A to C).
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 or 0 to 2, depending on module.
Access to a computer or tablet with camera, microphone, speakers, and internet (physical activity modules).
not_for: Major heart, lung, or active infectious conditions that would make participation unsafe.
Current symptomatic pathological fractures or unstable bones (physical activity modules).
Current beta-blocker use or use within 3 months (beta-blocker module).
Conditions that contraindicate beta-blockers, such as low blood pressure or severe asthma or COPD.
